xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ReasonForPartCOfAnnexureIOfThe:
The Board of Directors, at its meeting held on October 27, 2025, approved the acquisition of 51% equity shares of M/s. Peanutbutter and Jelly Private Limited, an unlisted company.
However, the said acquisition was completed in January 2026, i.e., after the end of the quarter under review.
Accordingly, during the quarter ended December 31, 2025, the Company has not acquired, directly or indirectly, any shares or voting rights in unlisted companies/subsidiaries in terms of sub-para (1) of para A of Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: Additional Commissioner, Central Goods and Services Tax, Tirupati
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The company has received demand order alleging flavored milk should be classified under GST Tariff Heading No. 2202 9930, attracting a tax rate of 6% CGST and 6% SGST. Consequently, it sought a differential GST liability of Rs.35.18 million for the period from July 2007 to March 2020, along with a penalty of Rs.35.28 million plus applicable interest. The Company has paid an amount of Rs.35.18 million under protest without prejudice to the rights and contentions of the law. The Company had filed a Writ Petition before the Hon’ble High Court of Andhra Pradesh challenging the demand order on 18-11-2021, After reviewing the matter, the Hon’ble High Court has issued a favorable order dated 29-01-2025 by setting aside the demand and court ruled that flavored milk falls under Tariff Heading No. 0402 9990, which attracting the tax rate of 2.5% CGST and 2.5% SGST and directed the Company to file the refund application for the differential tax already paid. The Company has received the favorable order from the Honorable High Court of AP on 29-01-2025. The Company has filed the refund application on 21/02/2025. The refund application is accepted by the department and sanctioned and withheld the refund on 22/04/2025 stating that the department is filing the SLP before Hon’ble Supreme Court of India. We have received the GST Refund of on 13/08/2025 amounting Rs.45.34 millions plus Interest amount of Rs.0.80 Millions
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: We have filed an appeal before the Appellate Commissioner CGST on 02/09/2025 for the interest amount of Rs.13.62 Millions (From the date of deposit of Tax to till the date of filing the refund application). On 17/11/2025, we have requested an early hearing of the appeal through letter dated 17/11/2025.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: Assistant Commissioner, Central Goods and Services Tax, West Division -6, Bengaluru, Karnataka
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The company has received demand order alleging flavored milk should be classified under GST Tariff Heading No. 2202 9930, attracting a tax rate of 6% CGST and 6% SGST. Expecting to receive the favorable order soon.
